skill.displayName: Anime Image Converter – Transform Your Photo into Anime Art with AI – API-powered
skill.summary: AI anime image converter — transform any photo into anime art style

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of anime-image-converter skill.
- Instantly transform any photo into anime art style using WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai and a WESHOP_API_KEY.
- Supports custom anime style instructions and batch image generation (up to 16).
- Secure handling of API keys emphasized: only send the key to official WeShop endpoints.
